caption: AI can help, but it isn't a substitute for verification. This carousel gives five prompts to verify AI-generated work before publishing. Diagnose, cite, improve tone, check flow, and refine with a final checklist. Which part will you start with today? #AIinBusiness #Productivity #AIQuality #ContentVerification

slides.title: Reality check: AI sounds right
slides.body: A polished AI draft hides errors and missing sources. Here are five prompts to systematically verify and fix it.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose accuracy
slides.body: Prompt 1: Paste draft {draft_text}. List each factual claim, mark True/False, cite sources. Output: bullet list with claim, verdict, sources.

slides.title: 2. Improve citations
slides.body: Prompt 2: For each claim lacking citation, generate a probable source placeholder and a brief rationale; output as list.

slides.title: 3. Apply improvements
slides.body: Prompt 3: Rewrite draft {draft_text} for target audience and tone; keep claims but improve clarity. Output: revised paragraph.

slides.title: 4. Check flow
slides.body: Prompt 4: Assess structure: introduction, body, conclusion; report on flow issues and suggest transitions. Output: list of issues and fixes.

slides.title: 5. Refine checklist
slides.body: Prompt 5: Produce a concise, auditable checklist {checklist_name}. Include criteria, owners, deadlines; format as numbered steps.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Verified AI outputs you can publish with confidence; follow the prompts to save time and avoid misstatements.
